Data validation report.

**Status:** Runs. In the palette under **Advanced operations > SQL and checks**.

Validates required, not-null, and unique column constraints and emits an issue report.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | validate, schema, quality, rules |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |

| **Issues** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Validation issues |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| required_columns | `required_columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Comma-separated required columns. |
| not_null_columns | `not_null_columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Columns that cannot contain nulls. |
| unique_columns | `unique_columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Columns that must be unique. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
